name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme for Excava’s interface. It matches the competitive analysis and Graphify’s central graph, reducing eye strain in low light and making interactive elements pop against dark backgrounds. Trade-off: some users prefer light themes for readability in bright rooms, but the liveliness and clarity of a dark interface outweigh that risk.

name: Pane
text: Dark themes fail users with astigmatism or color vision deficiency—glare isn’t the only strain. A toggle between dark and high-contrast light themes covers more edge cases without sacrificing the visual pop we want. Settle it with a 5-user usability test: if the light theme group performs faster on key tasks, we adopt the toggle; if not, dark theme stays.
